agenda_text:
CITY OF MONTEREY PARK CITY COUNCIL
  INTRODUCTION OF GUESTS AND PRESENTATIONS
  TUESDAY
  September 17, 2019
  6:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  320 WEST NEWMARK AVENUE
  Monterey Park, CA 91754

  CONGRATULATIONS!

  To Garfield High School for their achievement on being awarded the 2019 California
  School of Distinction Award. The City Council recognizes and commends your
 dedication, commitment, and hard work put forth towards advancing the education for
  our youth.

  Garfield High School

  (Presented by Council Member Real Sebastian)

  CONGRATULATIONS!

To Jorge Gurrola for creating Mazatli Footwear from the Anachuac people of Southern
Mexico. The City Council recognizes and commends your dedication to keep the culture
 of the Indigenous Anachuac people alive. The City Council further extends our best
  wishes for continued success in all your future endeavors.

  Jorge Gurrola

  (Presented by Council Member Real Sebastian)

  IN RECOGNITION!

To Kaylie Chuman and Yuumi Lloyd, two student ambassadors, who recently visited our
 sister city Nachikatsurra, Japan this past summer, for an Exchange Program. The City
  Council appreciate your contributions toward strengthening goodwill and cultural
  exchange between our cities and taking the opportunity to learn and understand the
  customs and cultures of Japan.

  Kaylie Chuman and Yuumi Lloyd

  (Requested by Council Member Chan)
